items.t: Nvidia weighs playing the cosigner for Nscale’s AI data center in West Virginia
items.s: When investors get nervous about AI spending, it helps to have the chipmaker that sells the chips offer to cosign the loan.

items.t: Ollie, a privacy-focused AI assistant, is shutting down
items.s: As an increasing number of AI assistants flood the market, the founder of Ollie, an assistant that respected its users' privacy, says it will be shutting down in a week.
